gloss: intermittence; on and off; starting and stopping

definitions.gloss: intermittence; on and off; starting and stopping
definitions.explanation: The pattern of repeatedly stopping and starting, or occurring at intervals rather than continuously. Almost always used in the adverbial form {断続的|だんぞくてき}に.

examples.japanese: ⟦{断続的|だんぞくてき}→断続的：15418_danzokuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}っている→降る：00839_furu⟧。
⟦{断続的|だんぞくてき}→断続的：15418_danzokuteki⟧な⟦{頭痛|ずつう}→頭痛：03369_zutsuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悩|なや}まされている→悩ます：12602_nayamasu⟧。

⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{断続的|だんぞくてき}→断続的：15418_danzokuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}われ→行う：01238_okonau⟧、⟦{最終的|さいしゅうてき}→最終的：13013_saishuuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合意|ごうい}→合意：05093_goui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}した→達する：02129_tassuru⟧。
examples.english: Negotiations were held intermittently, and ultimately an agreement was reached.

notes:
A compound of {断|だん} (to cut off, interrupt) and {続|ぞく} (to continue). The word combines two opposing concepts — interruption and continuation — to describe a pattern of repeated stopping and starting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{断続的|だんぞくてき}→断続的：15418_danzokuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: intermittently, on and off
- ⟦{断続的|だんぞくてき}→断続的：15418_danzokuteki⟧な⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧: intermittent rain
- ⟦{断続的|だんぞくてき}→断続的：15418_danzokuteki⟧な⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧: intermittent pain
- ⟦{断続的|だんぞくてき}→断続的：15418_danzokuteki⟧な⟦{渋滞|じゅうたい}→渋滞：03279_juutai⟧: stop-and-go traffic

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {間欠的|かんけつてき}: intermittent — more technical/scientific; used for geysers, fevers
- ⟦{連続|れんぞく}→連続：03783_renzoku⟧: continuous, consecutive — the antonym, meaning without interruption
- ⟦{継続|けいぞく}→継続：00213_keizoku⟧: continuation — sustained over time without the stopping-and-starting nuance

USAGE:
Most commonly appears as ⟦{断続的|だんぞくてき}→断続的：15418_danzokuteki⟧ (adjective) or ⟦{断続的|だんぞくてき}→断続的：15418_danzokuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (adverb). Very frequently used in weather forecasts (⟦{断続的|だんぞくてき}→断続的：15418_danzokuteki⟧な⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧) and news reports.
